question: Should `findOpenAIStrictSchemaViolations` become a supported public Plugin SDK export, or should this PR retain it as an internal AI-package helper?
rationale: A public SDK export is a durable external contract, while the PR description explicitly says the SDK surface should not grow; source review cannot safely choose that API direction on behalf of the owner.

options.title: Keep the helper internal
options.body: Remove the `provider-tools` re-export and baseline expansion while retaining the AI-package import needed by the core implementation.

options.title: Adopt a supported SDK API
options.body: Keep the export only with explicit owner approval, documented caller contract, and focused compatibility coverage for plugin consumers.

recommendation.title: Keep the helper internal
recommendation.body: Remove the `provider-tools` re-export and baseline expansion while retaining the AI-package import needed by the core implementation.
